description: Complete ownership and cross-module API contract for the Model Asset Editor. Every named function, class method and top-level module binding is owned. PURE core/presentation code may depend only on explicit function imports and explicit external libraries; runtime/editor effects remain in adapter/infrastructure roles. Portable modules are mechanically extracted and imported by check_model_asset_extraction_proof.py.

composition_root.policy: Module-scope DOM/event/bootstrap wiring remains effectful composition code. Physical extraction imports domain adapters/cores into this root; runtime state does not move into portable cores.
